title: SessionProtocolMessage
description: LiveKit data-channel messages (topic aloai.session) between the Session Agent (W2, producer) and the web app (W1, consumer). Agent to client: clip_list, play, step, show_passage, hide_passage, reconnecting. Client to agent: played, missing. The agent decides every step; the client only follows these messages and never moves the session on by itself. The client never shows a score, timer or red mark. schema_version 2 adds clip texts, the passage text on show_passage, and the step message.

clips.description: Clips the client caches (fully downloaded) before they are played. More than one clip_list can arrive in a session: the prompts at the start, the passage's clips when it is chosen, and a single clip streamed after a `missing`. Add each list to the cache.

text.description: Exactly what Auntie Kemi says in the clip, to show in the speech bubble while it plays. null for the listening story, whose words must stay audio-only (the listening module measures understanding without reading).

oneOf.description: The task the session is in. Sent whenever the agent moves to a new task, and again after a reconnect, so the client can clear its waiting screen. The client shows the screen for this step; it never advances the step itself.
Show the story for reading. Carries display text only: never the items, propositions or rubrics.

arl.description: The passage's Alo Reading Level, used only to pick the reading text size (design system ReadingPanel: ARL 1-2 p1, 3-6 p3, 7-12 p5). Never shown to the child: a level on the kid screen would read as a grade.

oneOf.description: Client to agent, only in reply to a `play`. `played`: the clip finished playing (the audio's `ended` event); the agent starts waiting for the child's answer from this moment. `missing`: the clip is not cached and could not be played; the agent streams it once with a one-clip clip_list followed by `play`. A client still downloading a clip waits for the download before answering.
